title: 1D Controller Blend: u=(1-L).K1.y+L.K2.y
text: Implement 1-D vector of state-space controllers by linear interpolation of their outputs, 2 inputs, 1 output; {A-matrix(v)} sets a -matrix of the state-space implementation, {B-matrix(v)} sets the b -matrix of the state-space implementation, {C-matrix(v)} sets the c -matrix of the state-space implementation, {D-matrix(v)} sets the d -matrix of the state-space implementation, {Scheduling variable breakpoints} sets the breakpoints for scheduling variable, {Initial state, x_initial} sets the initial states and {Poles of A(v)-H(v)*C(v) = [w1... wn])} sets the poles of observer. Values come from the instance.

params.name: A-matrix(v)
params.values: A -matrix of the state-space implementation A1 (default) | array

params.name: B-matrix(v)
params.values: B -matrix of the state-space implementation B1 (default) | array

params.name: C-matrix(v)
params.values: C -matrix of the state-space implementation C1 (default) | array

params.name: D-matrix(v)
params.values: D -matrix of the state-space implementation D1 (default) | array
